The bare numbers below are genuinely weak, context-gated shapes — the kind
whose base score sits well under the threshold, so without a nearby keyword
to vouch for them they must stay undetected and survive un-redacted. This is
the precision floor: an ambiguous number with no supporting evidence is left
alone rather than guessed at. Each value here is paired with a
keyword-bearing positive in heavy_contextual.txt.

The inventory line read 000123456789 in the third column.
Row 000987654321 was archived to cold storage overnight.
The lot was tagged 000555000555 during the warehouse audit.

These are ordinary bare numbers in ordinary sentences. No "account",
"checking", "bank", or other supporting keyword appears anywhere near them,
so the weak bank-account shape must not be flagged on a single one.
